# German.net

> Comprehensive online platform for learning German grammar, vocabulary, and verb conjugation through interactive exercises and reading comprehension materials.

German.net provides structured language learning resources for beginners to advanced learners (A1-B2 levels), with a focus on grammar mastery through practice exercises, verb conjugation tools, and vocabulary building. The platform offers both free and premium subscription options to support diverse learning needs.

## Key Topics

- German grammar
- Verb conjugation
- German cases (nominative, accusative, dative, genitive)
- Adjectives and endings
- Pronouns
- Prepositions
- Sentence construction
- Tenses (present, past, perfect)
- Vocabulary practice
- Reading comprehension
- Online exercises
- A1-B2 proficiency levels
- Interactive learning
- Irregular verbs
- German language

## Getting Started

- [German language - Grammar, Exercises and Vocabulary](https://german.net): Homepage offering German grammar, exercises, vocabulary, and verb conjugation for all levels.
- [German.net Premium](https://german.net/premium): Premium subscription page with pricing and membership features for German.net.

## Verb Conjugation & Tenses

- [German verb conjugation - practice verb tenses online](https://german.net/verbs/conjugation): Verb conjugation reference and practice for German tenses including present, past, and perfect.
- [Present Tense - German verb conjugation](https://german.net/verbs/conjugation/present): Reference guide for German present tense verb conjugation with interactive exercises.
- [Simple Past (Präteritum) - German verb conjugation](https://german.net/verbs/conjugation/simple-past): Reference for German simple past (Präteritum) with weak and strong verb conjugations.
- [German tenses & moods - online exercises](https://german.net/exercises/tenses): Online exercises for German verb tenses, moods, and temporal expressions.
- [German verbs & conjugation - online exercises](https://german.net/exercises/verbs): Conjugation practice for regular, irregular, and reflexive German verbs.

## Grammar Fundamentals

- [German cases - accusative, dative, nominative and genitive exercises](https://german.net/exercises/cases): Grammar exercises for German cases: nominative, accusative, dative, and genitive declension.
- [German nouns & articles - online grammar exercises](https://german.net/exercises/nouns): Grammar exercises for German nouns, articles, and case agreement.
- [German adjectives - Exercises about endings, comparative & superlative](https://german.net/exercises/adjectives): Adjective exercises covering endings, comparative, superlative, and case agreement.
- [German pronouns - online grammar exercises](https://german.net/exercises/pronouns): Grammar exercises for personal, reflexive, relative, and possessive German pronouns.
- [German prepositions - online grammar exercises](https://german.net/exercises/prepositions): Grammar exercises for German prepositions with accusative and dative cases.

## Advanced Grammar & Syntax

- [German sentence construction - grammar exercises](https://german.net/exercises/sentences): Exercises for German sentence construction, word order, and clause formation.
- [German passive voice - online grammar exercises](https://german.net/exercises/passive): Grammar exercises for German passive voice construction and verb conjugation.
- [German conjunctions - online grammar exercises](https://german.net/exercises/conjunctions): Grammar exercises for German conjunctions and conjunction usage rules.
- [German adverbs - online grammar exercises](https://german.net/exercises/adverbs): Online exercises for German adverbs and verb modification.

## Vocabulary & Reading

- [German vocabulary](https://german.net/vocabulary): Interactive vocabulary builder with word lists and quizzes for German language learners.
- [German Reading and Comprehension - Texts for Beginners](https://german.net/reading): Reading comprehension texts and exercises for A1-B2 German learners with printable PDFs.

## Practice Exercises

- [German exercises - practice grammar online](https://german.net/exercises): Online grammar practice exercises covering pronouns, adjectives, and multiple-choice drills.
- [German numbers - Exercises to learn the numbers](https://german.net/exercises/numbers): Exercises for learning cardinal and ordinal numbers in German.
